jobs.title: Advanced Design Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is responsible for advancing the development of new golf club head designs, materials, manufacturing technologies, and engineering processes to support the next generation of breakthrough products. As a key member of the Asia Advanced Design team, this role supports advanced design projects aligned with TaylorMade's long-term technology and product development roadmap. Working closely with suppliers across Asia and global R&D teams, the position provides technical leadership through project management, innovation, problem solving, research, testing, and product validation. Travel within Asia, including Vietnam and China, may be required to support project execution and maintain strong collaboration with suppliers and cross-functional partners.

This position requires proficiency in leading suppliers, planning, design studies and evaluation, process studies, materials (including metals, polymers, carbon composites), analysis, prototyping, testing, and manufacturing processes relevant to golf club heads. Experience in one or more manufacturing processes is required, with preference given to candidates who have exposure to multiple manufacturing technologies, including casting, forging, machining, forming, welding, heat treatment, surface finishing and coating processes, molding, joining technologies, additive manufacturing, and automation. To drive successful results, this role also requires aptitude in project management, time management, critical thinking, detailed problem solving, efficient, accurate and complete communication, collaboration, reporting and documentation in a fast-paced environment.

**Essential Functions and Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to support team growth, collaboration, and engineering excellence.
* Collaborate with suppliers, Asia-based teams, and global R&D partners to stay aligned with and support technology roadmaps, product development projects, and manufacturing
